title: 47. What do I do to prevent robots from submitting multiple contributions to my survey?
intent: This troubleshooting article helps EUSurvey survey managers resolve or understand the issue: What do I do to prevent robots from submitting multiple contributions to my survey.
short_answer: Automatic scripts can falsify the outcome of an online survey by submitting a high number of contributions. To prevent this, you can use EUSurvey to make participants solve a CAPTCHA (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CAPTCHA) challenge before submitting a contribution.
procedure: You can enable/disable the CAPTCHA in the 'Security' settings under 'Properties'.
N.B. Although this won't make fraud impossible, it might discourage people from continuing to try to falsify survey results.
